description: Java class 'XMLFilter' extending FileFilter for filtering XML files, specifically ECU definition files, with methods for accepting files, managing extensions, and generating descriptions.

classes.name: XMLFilter
classes.description: A custom file filter for XML files, primarily used for ECU definition files, with configurable description and extension handling.

methods.name: XMLFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with default extension 'xml' and description 'ECU Definition Files'.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a file is accepted based on being a directory or having a valid extension.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a given File object.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the filter's list of accepted extensions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the filter, including extensions if configured.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description string for the filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Configures whether to include the extension list in the description.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Checks if the extension list is included in the description.
